==Notes==
*This Form uses female ranger animations, regardless of your character's gender or profession.
*All actions (including skill activations, attacks, and movement) will be canceled when this form ends.
*Take note of when this form will end and watch your health. The extra health granted by this form is taken away when it ends, potentially lowering your health to negative values; this won't kill you outright, but taking any damage or degeneration, or even being healed or receiving regeneration that does not immediately raise your health above zero will.
*The [[hero]] [[M.O.X.]] has a unique model for this form.
